18.description: This feature vector activates on common Thai syllable prefixes, vowel markers, and recurring functional word fragments.

97.description: This vector activates for common Thai noun prefixes and abstract nominal roots.

99.description: These tokens represent Thai quantifiers, determiners, and words denoting amounts, numbers, or distributions.

10.description: This vector activates strongly for Thai script characters, numerals, and unrelated noise tokens.

167.description: This vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ม' (Mo Ma) and its combinations with various Thai vowels and tone marks.

63.description: This feature vector is related to common Thai words and morphological components used in the Thai language.

177.description: This vector represents the Thai consonant letter "ต" (to tao) appearing at the end of syllables or words as a final stop consonant.

195.description: These tokens represent subwords or characters frequently occurring within Thai words related to general concepts, grammar, or common vocabulary containing the Thai consonant 'ส' (So Sua).

131.description: This vector represents a multilingual mixture of subword tokens spanning various scripts and semantic contexts without a single cohesive concept.

163.description: This feature vector represents Thai script characters and linguistic sub-tokens.
